'''Corey Demario''' (Japanese: 	'''ツヨシ''' ''Tsuyoshi'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[HS17|Those Darn Electabuzz!]]''.

Corey was the star pitcher for the {{p|Electabuzz}} [[baseball]] team. He is {{an|Casey}}'s idol, being the star of her favorite team. Following a shoulder injury, which lead Corey to leave the game, his younger brother [[Benny Demario|Benny]] had been looking after Corey's {{p|Charizard}} for him.

After a chance encounter at a park, Casey decided to help Corey train the Pokémon. Eventually, she discovered that neither of them were confident in themselves, which caused their skills to lack. Corey's father [[Shigeo]] also revealed that Corey's shoulder injury was already healed, though his son had decided not to return to baseball for some reason. Thank to Casey's pep and push, Charizard soon improved, and Corey's confidence rose as well and he returned to baseball soon after.

==Trivia==
* His Charizard's nickname is intended to be a play on its Japanese name, "Lizar''don''".
* The name Demario may come from Hall of Famer {{wp|Joe DiMaggio}} of the New York Yankees. However, DiMaggio is an outfielder, not a pitcher.
